scope: WeaponTypeClass::GetSpeed over ROT/Floater/gravity/distance, FireAt's launch distance block over signed deltas incl. signed32 overflow, and the aim point 0x0070BCB0 over target class, motion, speed, body facing, distance, gravity, projectile ROT/Speed, a missing weapon and a missing target.
assumptions: x87 control word 0x0E7F (PC53, chop), the harness default.
The target FacingClass at +0x388 has rate 0 (Current returns the stored facing).
0x00B0EA90..0x00B0EA98 (the aim's starting coordinate) are the zero-filled BSS.
substitutions: target vt+0x58 / vt+0x48 return the case's target coordinate
firer vt+0x48 returns the case's firer coordinate
target vt+0x2C returns the case's What_Am_I; vt+0x538 its current speed
target locomotor ILocomotion vt+0x10 Is_Moving returns the case's flag
firer vt+0x3F4 GetCurrentWeapon returns a Weapon struct naming the case's weapon
